entries.title: Find a closed card again on its task
entries.body: A task's record now has a Cards row that lists every card the task showed, newest first, with how each one ended. Open a closed card to read it again, with its figures and your choice, and nothing on it can be clicked. Closing a card also says in the Activity feed that it stays on the task's record.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.
